messages:
Maya (partnerships): Axiom sent a proposal to run a public perf story on their T52. They want numbers for perf/W and tokens/s plus a short methods appendix. Can we scope a minimal public matrix that still shows signal? @Ben @Jordan @Leo please chime in.
Ben (eng-runtime): Minimal but credible: three models (7b, 13b, 70b), two quant modes (int8, int4), and three batch sizes (1, 8, 32). Kernel variants: stock, flash-attn-v3, and T52-tuned GEMM. Keep fp16 out of public unless partner insists.
Jordan (eng-ml): Agreed. We'll run quality checks on our standard prompts and report delta-ROUGE / delta-exact-match where appropriate. Public table should include energy/token and p95 latency.
Leo (eng-infra): Telemetry needs: PDU power at 1s, ambient temp, wall power, and host-side token timings. We'll tag runs with firmware_rev and kernel_variant. Also recommend a canonical run ID to quote in PR.
Asha (cust-success): For marketing: embargo window needed, and legal review of partner wording. Also confirm no customer data. Evan: can Axiom sign embargo?
Evan (AxiomAccel): Yes, embargo OK. We can provide 3 systems in SF and remote access. Firmware on lab units is 1.2.0. 1.3 candidate is unstable; we can run it in a "tech preview" bucket but not quote in press. PDUs available.
Maya (partnerships): Proposal: week 1 dry-run (single model small matrix), week 2 full run, week 3 validation + writeup. Mid-May embargo target. Does that fit?
Ben (eng-runtime): Fits. I'll own the runbook and will include the exact run command snippets. Example command to capture metadata: 
```bash
./run_bench \
  --model redwood-open-7b \
  --quant int8 \
  --kernel t52-gemm \
  --batch 8 \
  --out s3://redwood-benching/axiom/t52/{run_ts}/ \
  --tags firmware=1.2.0,run_id=axiom_t52_public
```
Jordan (eng-ml): I'll prepare the eval prompts and a small script to compute quality deltas. Gate: if perplexity worsens >2% on int4 vs int8, we add a footnote.
Leo (eng-infra): I'll create bench ingestion, set alert if power variance > 15% across repeats, and snapshot kernel counters via `axiom-prof`. We'll also log ambient temp.
Evan (AxiomAccel): Shipping checklist sent. Lab ready Tue (1955680800). We'll provide PDU endpoints and /metrics agent for chip-level power.
Infra Bot: bench-run queued: id=axiom-t52-public-1955604321, owner=ben, matrix=3models x {int8,int4} x 3batch-sizes.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: Ben runbook, Jordan evals, Leo telemetry, Evan hardware + PDU ACL, Asha draft PR outline. I'll coordinate legal. Next sync after dry-run. :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-runtime): Will upload runbook by EOD.
Jordan (eng-ml): Starting prompts prep now.
Evan (AxiomAccel): Confirmed: embargo mid-May OK; 3 systems available.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — closing thread, post updates here.
